Magnificent Seven AI Debt Climbs 45% to $578 Billion

SBI Research has reported that the debt of the 'Magnificent Seven' technology companies has surged by 45% to $578 billion. This increase in borrowing is raising concerns about financial vulnerabilities within the technology sector, attributed to rising borrowing costs, bond yields, and infrastructure commitments related to artificial intelligence investments. Separately, Singapore's ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) is reportedly seeking a $2.4 billion loan, adding to the trend of significant debt accumulation for AI infrastructure.
